title: 赤字率4%之外：还有1.3万亿，明年扩张性政策能否延续？
speaker: Zhu Guangyao

segments.en: Sometimes, big effort in new model of development, that's AI, that's modernized industry, that's great contribution to China's development. Do you think that when it comes to the official headline deficit to GDP ratio, that is something that might need to be tweaked in 2027?
segments.zh: 有时，新模式发展的大力度，比如人工智能、现代化产业，对中国发展贡献巨大。您认为到2027年，官方赤字率是否需要调整？

segments.en: We have currently full percent of fiscal deficit, but we have this extra long-term government-bound issue, that's 1.3 trillion.
segments.zh: 我们目前财政赤字率是百分之几，但还有额外长期政府债券发行，规模1.3万亿。

segments.en: I guess next year that some policy continue, so we have this expansion or fiscal policy, and let's make our economy develop smoothly and keep this momentum 4.5 percent to 5 percent growth.
segments.zh: 我猜明年一些政策会延续，所以我们有这种扩张性或财政政策，让经济平稳发展，保持4.5%到5%的增长势头。
